title: Case: Part of a two-carton desk order has not arrived
context: Order TG-2705 was shipped as two separately labelled cartons. Both show delivery scans from the same day, made at different times and in different ways.
initial_request: Only half of TG-2705 has shown up. Your tracking says the whole lot is delivered. Where is the rest? I took a day off work for this and I'm not paying for a desk I can't build.

events.from: Ulric Haverly, sender not on record
events.body: Hello, I'm not on the order but I live nearby. Just so you know, the driver told me DL-2107 was handed to someone at the door, so it's been delivered.

TG-2705 for Xanthe Kittering left us today as two cartons on separate labels: DL-2107 standing desk frame (long flat carton, 31 kg) and DL-2526 desk top (square carton, 18 kg). Both handed to Fallowmere Arc at 15:10.

End of day status for TG-2705. DL-2107: delivery scan 2028-04-05 10:12, driver note 'left in porch'. DL-2526: delivery scan 2028-04-05 15:47, different driver, note 'handed to resident'. Both closed on our side.
Only half of TG-2705 has shown up. Your tracking says the whole lot is delivered. Where is the rest? I took a day off work for this and I'm not paying for a desk I can't build.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask which of the two cartons has arrived: the desk frame (DL-2107) or the desk top (DL-2526).
Ask which of the two cartons has arrived: the desk frame (DL-2107) or the desk top (DL-2526). (by Email, the channel the escalation arrived on)

must: Asks Xanthe Kittering which carton has arrived and which is missing, naming the desk frame (DL-2107) and the desk top (DL-2526) or their label references
Sends the question to Xanthe Kittering before any trace is requested
Avoids stating that the missing carton is lost, stolen or delivered
must_not: Asks the Parcel trace team or Dispatch to trace DL-2107 on the assumption that the porch-drop carton is the missing one
Tells Xanthe Kittering that the missing carton was delivered, or that it is lost or stolen
Promises a refund, a replacement or a redelivery date
Asks for anything beyond which carton arrived, such as proof of identity, a door code or payment details
Treats the claim from Ulric Haverly (who has no recorded link to DL-2107) as confirmed
Closes the case or tells anyone the matter is resolved on the strength of Ulric Haverly's message
expected.reference_message: I am sorry part of your order is missing. TG-2705 was sent as two cartons with their own labels: the desk frame (long flat carton, label DL-2107) and the desk top (square carton, label DL-2526). Please tell me which one you have received, or the DL number on the label of the carton that did arrive. With that I can ask the carrier to trace the right one. I cannot say yet where the other carton is.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-302: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The escalation arrives by Email instead of Customer portal; replying on either channel is accepted. An unverified bystander, Ulric Haverly, claims something that would end the case; it is not a record and the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
